does: Turns a dense generated model into a light mesh of four-sided faces that a game can animate.
headline: artist_rings

creature_bend.label: Bends well (creatures)
creature_bend.means: How cleanly the owner's five new creatures bend at 10,000 triangles, each on its own rig and range of motion (weightforge's score, 0-100, middle of five). Higher is better.

creature_shape.label: Shape error (creatures)
creature_shape.means: How far the new mesh strays from the download, as a share of the creature's size (95th percentile, middle of five). Under 0.3 is hard to see.

creature_worst.label: Worst shape error
creature_worst.means: The farthest the new mesh strays from the download (middle of five creatures). A lost horn, claw or spine shows up here.

joint_loops.label: Rings at joints
joint_loops.means: Closed edge rings around each limb near its joint (0 to 3 per joint, averaged; middle of five creatures). Rings let a knee or elbow bend without folding; 2 or more is good.

artist_rings.label: Loops where artists put them
artist_rings.means: Given only the shape of 20 hand-made meshes (heads, hands, feet, bones, props), the share of the artist's closed edge rings the remesh also has, at the artist's own face count. 100 is the artist's own mesh.

artist_shape.label: Shape error (artist set)
artist_shape.means: How far the remesh strays from the shape (95th percentile, middle of 20). Lost thin parts show here.

reference.label: QuadWild + Bi-MDF (free research remesher)
reference.means: QuadWild on the same 20 meshes and counts; creature bend reference stays Blender Decimate (79.9).

rounds.changed: First round on the new creature bench (each creature rigged once, every mesh bent on that rig). Retopoforge as it stood loses to plain decimate: it drops horns and spines, melts fur, and makes no rings at joints.

One joint bent 60 degrees: retopoforge (left), plain decimate (right).

rounds.changed: A finer working mesh, odd faces turned into quads, exact face counts: rings where artists put them 22.5% -> 32.1% (level with QuadWild), edge flow the closest of all tools; still loses thin separate parts.
